name: generates the first four rows and their rendering
keeps numeric data separate from formatting
test:
rows = generate_pascal(6)
assert rows[-1] == [1, 5, 10, 10, 5, 1]
assert [sum(row) for row in rows] == [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32]
lines = render_pascal(6)
assert len(lines) == 6
assert all(line == line.rstrip() for line in lines)
assert '10' in lines[-1]
